ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

ayahOccurrences.text: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

عَرَضَ ʿaraḍa i [v. trans.]

entries.label: أَعْرَضَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَعْرَضَ ʾaʿaraḍa [v. IV intrans., with prep. عَن]

1 to turn away from, to reject

(18:57) وَمَنْ‏ ‏أَظْلَمُ‏ ‏مِمَّنْ‏ ‏ذُكِّرَ‏ ‏بِآيَاتِ‏ ‏رَبِّهِ‏ ‏فَأَعْرَضَ‏ ‏عَنْهَا‏ ‏ who could be more misguided than the person who is reminded of his Lord’s messages and turns his back on them?

2 to ignore, to overlook

(66:3) ‏عَرَّفَ‏ ‏بَعْضَهُ‏ ‏وَأَعْرَضَ‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏بَعْضٍ he took [her] to task for [lit. pointed out] part of it and ignored the other

3 to let be, leave alone

(9:95) سَيَحْلِفُونَ‏ ‏بِاللَّهِ‏ ‏لَكُمْ‏ ‏إِذَا‏ ‏انْقَلَبْتُمْ‏ ‏إِلَيْهِمْ‏ ‏لِتُعْرِضُوا‏ ‏عَنْهُمْ‏ when you return to them, they will swear to you by God in order to make you leave them alone.

entries.label: إِعْرَاضٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
إِعْرَاضٌ ʾiʿrāḍ [v. n.] rejection, shunning, alienation

(4:128) وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا and if a woman experiences from her husband rejection or alienation.

entries.label: عَارِضٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَارِضٌ ʿāriḍ [act. part.] approaching on a broad front, a cloud traversing the sky

(46:24) فَلَمَّا‏ ‏رَأَوْهُ‏ ‏عَارِضًا‏ ‏مُسْتَقْبِلَ‏ ‏أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ‏‏ when they saw it as a traversing cloud approaching their valleys.

entries.label: عَرَضٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَرَضٌ ʿarad [n.]

1 something transient *

(8:67) عَرَض الدُنْيا ephemeral riches and pleasures of this life [as opposed to that of the Hereafter]‏

2 an errand, gain, benefit

(9:42) لَوْ‏ ‏كَانَ‏ ‏عَرَضًا‏ ‏قَرِيبًا‏ were it a gain near at hand.

entries.label: عَرِيضٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَرِيضٌ ʿarıḍ [quasi‐act. part.] extensive, far reaching

(41:51)‏‏فَذُو‏ ‏دُعَاءٍ‏ ‏عَرِيضٍ‏ he is full of prolonged prayer.

entries.label: عَرَّضَ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَرَّضَ ʿarraḍa [v. II intrans., with prep. ﺒ] to hint at, to insinuate

(2:235) وَلاَ‏ ‏جُنَاحَ‏ ‏عَلَيْكُمْ‏ ‏فِيمَا‏ ‏عَرَّضْتُمْ‏ ‏بِهِ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏خِطْبَةِ‏ ‏النِّسَاءِ‏ no blame will be attached to you if you give a hint that you wish to marry [these] women.

entries.definitionHtml:
عَرْضٌ ʿarḍ I [v. n. of v. عَرُضَ ʿaruḍa u] width, breadth

entries.label: عُرِضَ
entries.definitionHtml:
عُرِضَ ʿuriḍa [pass. v.]

1 to be put on view, to be exposed

(69:18) يَوْمَئِذٍ‏ ‏تُعْرَضُونَ‏ ‏لاَ‏ ‏تَخْفَى‏ ‏مِنْكُمْ‏ ‏خَافِيَةٌ‏ on that Day you will be exposed (or, you will be brought to judgement) and not one of your secrets will remain hidden 2‏ to be presented, to be put on view

(38:31) إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ when, at the close of the day, well‐bred light‐footed horses were paraded before him.

entries.label: عُرْضَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عُرْضَةٌ ʿurḍatun [n.] ready subject, butt; obstacle

(2:224) وَلاَ‏ ‏تَجْعَلُوا‏ ‏اللَّهَ‏ ‏عُرْضَةً‏ ‏لأَِيْمَانِكُمْ‏ broadly interpreted either as: do not make God the butt of your oaths or, do not make God‐backed oaths [not to perform a charitable act] an obstacle between you and doing good.

entries.label: مُعْرِِضُون
entries.definitionHtml:
مُعْرِِضُون muʿriḍūn [pl. of act. part. مُعْرِض muʿriḍ] those who shun, reject or turn away from

(6:4) كَانُوا‏ ‏عَنْهَا‏ ‏مُعْرِضِينَ‏ they turn their backs on it.
